content: In the header of a file, can there be several names next to the copyright? I've never seen it before but this came up in a PR.
The Finprod file has multiple for example
Ah yes, well I guess it's fine then.
Archive/Sensitivity.lean also has a lot of examples.

I think there are hundreds of files with this, and there seems to be no consensus whether to separate using commas or and: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/d4d96de5f1db55fe964b5b682e22923996833e88/Mathlib/FieldTheory/Galois/Basic.lean#L2 has Copyright (c) 2020 Thomas Browning, Patrick Lutz. All rights reserved., while https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/d4d96de5f1db55fe964b5b682e22923996833e88/Mathlib/FieldTheory/AbelRuffini.lean#L2 has Copyright (c) 2020 Thomas Browning and Patrick Lutz. All rights reserved..
